rationale: A two-stage asynchronous-assert, synchronous-release reset synchroniser in dst_clk drives local_rst_n. The only functional register uses that synchronised reset. The contract makes recovery/removal and placement external obligations. This is the one case where the design and contract cover the whole IP.
caveats: Expected findings are RDC-003 INFO (recognised synchroniser), RDC-013 (a physical obligation that fires for any asynchronous reset), and RDC-002(a) WARNING Unresolved, because rst_n is named by no SDC path exception. If the scorer counts RDC-002 or RDC-013 as noise, no reset-bearing design can be clean. The maintainer must set that policy. Adding a false-path on rst_n could in turn trigger RDC-027.
src_clk is unused. local_rst_n is not used in any other domain.

labels.rationale: Two stages asynchronously assert low and synchronously shift released high in dst_clk. Functional reset is driven only by final stage, giving local synchronized release.
labels.caveats: Eligible as a small whole-IP structural control before physical closure under local reset-output use; physical recovery/removal, metastability and placement still need closure. No claim for use of local_rst_n in another clock domain.
